name: Frederica Ahlqvist
original_name: フレデリカ・アールクヴィスト
source:
[b]The Soothing Sweetheart: A Playful Transfer Student[/b]

"Uh, um…! This mochi looks exactly like my pet hamster! It’s way too cute to eat…!"

A stunning transfer student who's both impishly playful and naturally demure - that's Frederica.
Our protagonist quickly discovers she's the perfect target: tease her and you'll either get an adorably flustered reaction or the most precious responses imaginable. These daily doses of playful torment have become her secret weapon for fitting in - now known as "Fren" to her classmates, she's found her place through these interactions. 
Fresh off her transfer but already assigned to the seat next to our hero, she's beginning to feel those delicate stirrings of romance.

On Dating:
"W-well, who am I to judge if two people are happy being lovey-dovey? Though I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous."

Charm Points
Takes jealousy to a whole new level

Character Gap
Get on her bad side, and you'll learn the hard way - she can hold a grudge like nobody's business
